bibl.title: The destruction of the Serapeum of Alexandria, its library, and the immediate reactions.
bibl.note: Epiphanius, the relocation of the Septuagint, and the end date of the Serapeum. - Possible allusions to the end of the Library in the sermons of John Chrysostom. - Aphthonius and the Serapeum ekphrasis. - Extant accounts of the end of the Serapeum. - A rereading of the corrupt passage on the Serapeum in Ammianus Marcellinus. - Conclusion.
